Agrawal Productionmanager, Goyal Building, Near Bus Stand, Occupation: Guna (Madhya Pradesh) Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140191775/ 1 Signature Not Verified Signed by: Yogendra Ojha Signing time: 12-06-2024 01:11:11 Pm 2 (By Shri Sushant Tiwari - Public Prosecutor) This application coming on for hearing this day, the co following: Order
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits though in Para 9 of the said judgment, it has been observed by learned trial Court that there was no sanction given by the Competent Authority as provided under Section 20 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954. The case of accused S.S. Agarwal, Production Manager of the Company and the Directors who are present petitioners is similar and therefore, deserves to be met with a similar fate. Since accused S.S. Agarwal has already been acquitted by the trial Court, no purpose would be served in keeping the matter pending treating the petitioners absconding. It was further submitted that against the order of acquittal, to the best of his knowledge, no appeal has been 3 MCRC-4788-2008 preferred by the State which goes to show that the judgment passed in the matter of accused S.S. Agarwal has been accepted by the State. Thus, it was prayed that the said observations made in Para 17 of the said judgment be deleted. 3. Per contra, Shri Tiwari though opposes the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioner but fairly admits that the allegations levelled against accused S.S.Agarwal, Production Manager and the petitioners were same and, to the best of his knowledge, no appeal has been preferred by the State and if this Court, deems it fit, may delete the said observation. 4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusing the record, this Court finds that the case of the petitioner is akin to the case of accused S.S. Agarwal, Production Manager of the Company against whom, the trial was conducted and vide impugned judgment dated 17.02.2008, he was acquitted.

The case of accused S.S. Agarwal, Production Manager of the Company and the Directors who are present petitioners is similar and therefore, deserves to be met with a similar fate. Since accused S.S. Agarwal has already been acquitted by the trial Court, no purpose would be served in keeping the matter pending treating the petitioners absconding. It was further submitted that against the order of acquittal, to the best of his knowledge, no appeal has been 3 MCRC-4788-2008 preferred by the State which goes to show that the judgment passed in the matter of accused S.S. Agarwal has been accepted by the State. Thus, it was prayed that the said observations made in Para 17 of the said judgment be deleted. 3. Per contra, Shri Tiwari though opposes the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioner but fairly admits that the allegations levelled against accused S.S.Agarwal, Production Manager and the petitioners were same and, to the best of his knowledge, no appeal has been preferred by the State and if this Court, deems it fit, may delete the said observation. 4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusing the record, this Court finds that the case of the petitioner is akin to the case of accused S.S. Agarwal, Production Manager of the Company against whom, the trial was conducted and vide impugned judgment dated 17.02.2008, he was acquitted.
